title: etaleSetPullback_eq_sheafEquivalence
statement: For schemes X and X' and a universal homeomorphism u : X' → X, the inverse functor of the chosen sheaf equivalence is naturally isomorphic to the set-valued etale inverse-image functor: Nonempty ((sheafEquivalence (Type (u + 1)) u).symm.functor ≅ Scheme.etaleSetPullback u).

proof.text: The constructed set-valued inverse image is left adjoint to lowerStar by the continuous-functor sheaf pullback adjunction. The inverse of sheafEquivalence is also left adjoint to this same functor by the equivalence adjunction. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq compares these left adjoints; invert its natural isomorphism for the displayed orientation. Uniqueness yields a natural isomorphism, not equality of functors.
